name: Cuerda-Feed-total
author: cuerda

sections.description:
Cuerda-Feed-total is a powerful tool for media companies to distribute content from a WordPress site to multiple news portals.
It eliminates the need to develop separate RSS feeds for each partner’s specifications and makes automated content distribution simple.

To use this plugin, you must apply for usage with your site URL and contact email.
Once submitted, a license will be issued from the external management system, and the plugin becomes available.

The license is provided free of charge until the end of the month following the issue date.
After the trial period, the plugin will stop working unless a paid license is purchased.
For details, see How to purchase a license.

Supported media:
* Yahoo! News（JAPAN）
* Yahoo! JAPAN Timeline（JAPAN）
* LINE NEWS（JAPAN）
* Gunosy, NewsPass, au Service Today（JAPAN）
* dmenu News（JAPAN）
* docomo Media（JAPAN）
* SmartNews（JAPAN）
* nordot (Use Smartformat for SmartNews)
* livedoor News（JAPAN）
* Rakuten Infoseek（JAPAN）
* TRILL（JAPAN）
* antenna*（JAPAN）
* SPORTS BULL（JAPAN）


Japanese language support is currently provided by bundled translation files.

In the future, we plan to migrate to the official WordPress.org translation system (translate.wordpress.org).

Terms of Use

See here.

Privacy Policy

See here.

Uninstall

When Cuerda-Feed-total is uninstalled, it will remove all plugin data from the database.
Specifically, all options and transients with the cuerda_ prefix, as well as the post meta key cuerda_revision_status, will be deleted across all sites (including multisite networks).

Features

  • Complies with the RSS feed specifications required by each media partner
  • Automatically transforms post content into the required format for each partner
  • Configure inclusion/exclusion rules per category, tag, or author
  • Automatic related article links
  • New posts, updates, and deletions are automatically reflected in partner feeds
  • Parses post content to output standard regional codes
  • Automatically distributes featured images set in posts
  • Many other configuration options available

Learn more

License

Cuerda-Feed-total requires a license.
First, apply for usage with your site URL and contact email.
A free license will be issued via the external management system and is valid until the end of the following month.
After the free period, the plugin will stop working unless a license is purchased.
See here for details on purchasing a license.
sections.installation:
1. Go to the Plugins page in the WordPress admin and click Add New.
  2. Enter “Cuerda-Feed-total” in the search box and click Install.
  3. After installation, click Activate.
  4. Apply for usage.
  5. Once you receive confirmation that the license has been issued, the plugin’s full functionality becomes available.
  6. From the WordPress admin, go to Settings → Cuerda Feed Settings to start configuration.
sections.faq:
What information is required for the application?

  • The domain where Cuerda-Feed-total will be used (e.g., www.cuerda.org)
  • Optionally, the development environment domain (e.g., dev.cuerda.org)
  • Contact email address

Why is the application required?

It authorizes license validation access from the specified domain to the external Cuerda management server.
This enables the use of the Cuerda-Feed-total plugin.

Is this plugin paid?

Yes. Cuerda-Feed-total requires a monthly paid license.
See here for purchasing options.

Can I use it for free?

Yes. All functions are free until the end of the month following the license issue date.
After that, the plugin’s functionality will be limited unless a license is purchased.

Can I use it on a non-public development environment?

Yes. If a paid license is purchased for the production site, the development environment site can be used for free.

Can I use it for a short period or cancel midway?

Yes. Mid-term cancellation is possible by notifying us via email.
The license fee for the cancellation month will be prorated.

How is the license paid?

Payment is monthly, billed in arrears. Bank transfer and credit card are accepted.

Can individuals purchase a license?

Yes. Both individuals and companies can purchase licenses.

Is communication with an external server required for license validation?

Yes. Periodic communication with the external server is required.
If this communication does not occur, the plugin’s functionality will be limited.

What information is sent for license validation?

The plugin accesses the external server via GET, along with referrer info from RSS feed crawlers.
It validates the license by receiving an HTTP status code (e.g., 200 OK).

How can I get support?

The following free support is available by email or online meeting (Japanese only):
– Plugin configuration assistance
– Pre-distribution tests required by some partners
– License payment consultation
